defects.justification: A negative Content-Length (e.g. -1) passes the `length > MAX_BODY_BYTES` check and rfile.read(-1) then reads until EOF, so the 64 KiB body cap is bypassed and an unauthenticated client can make the server buffer an unbounded body.

ThreadingHTTPServer/BaseHTTPRequestHandler is used with no socket timeout and unlimited threads, so slow or stalled clients (slowloris, or a short body under a larger Content-Length) each pin a thread indefinitely.
GET /orders/<id> has no authentication at all, so anyone who can reach the service can read any order's amount and payment status by guessing ids.
The amount is only checked for payment.* events; refund.created of any amount (including a partial or zero refund) moves the whole order to 'refunded'.
